constraints.name: ck_bo_dem_tien_to
constraints.definition: CHECK (((tien_to)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PN'::character varying, 'HD'::character varying, 'TH'::character varying, 'KK'::character varying, 'XH'::character varying, 'SP'::character varying, 'NCC'::character varying, 'KM'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_chuong_trinh_khuyen_mai_trang_thai_enum
constraints.definition: CHECK (((trang_thai)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['NHAP'::character varying, 'DA_KICH_HOAT'::character varying, 'TAM_DUNG'::character varying, 'DA_KET_THUC'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_ct_phieu_doi_tra_ly_do_enum
constraints.definition: CHECK (((ly_do)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['LOI_SAN_PHAM'::character varying, 'HET_HAN'::character varying, 'KHONG_DUNG_NHU_CAU'::character varying, 'KHAC'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_ct_xuat_huy_ly_do_enum
constraints.definition: CHECK (((ly_do)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['HONG'::character varying, 'HET_HAN'::character varying, 'MAT'::character varying, 'KHAC'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_ctkm_gia_tri
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((loai_giam)::text = 'PHAN_TRAM'::text) AND ((gia_tri >= 1) AND (gia_tri <= 100)) AND ((giam_toi_da IS NULL) OR ((giam_toi_da > 0) AND ((giam_toi_da % (100)::bigint) = 0)))) OR (((loai_giam)::text = 'SO_TIEN'::text) AND (gia_tri > 0) AND ((gia_tri % (100)::bigint) = 0) AND (giam_toi_da IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_gdtm_balance
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((loai)::text = 'THU_BAN_HANG'::text) AND (so_du_sau = (so_du_truoc + so_tien))) OR (((loai)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['CHI_HOAN_TRA'::character varying, 'CHI_HUY_HOA_DON'::character varying])::text[])) AND (so_du_truoc = (so_du_sau + so_tien))) OR ((loai)::text = 'CHOT_SO_DU_DAU'::text)))

constraints.name: ck_gdtm_link
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((loai)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['THU_BAN_HANG'::character varying, 'CHI_HUY_HOA_DON'::character varying])::text[])) AND (hoa_don_id IS NOT NULL) AND (phieu_doi_tra_id IS NULL) AND (so_tien > 0)) OR (((loai)::text = 'CHI_HOAN_TRA'::text) AND (hoa_don_id IS NULL) AND (phieu_doi_tra_id IS NOT NULL) AND (so_tien > 0)) OR (((loai)::text = 'CHOT_SO_DU_DAU'::text) AND (hoa_don_id IS NULL) AND (phieu_doi_tra_id IS NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim((ghi_chu)::text), ''::text) IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_gio_hang_trang_thai_enum
constraints.definition: CHECK (((trang_thai)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['DANG_BAN'::character varying, 'TAM_GIU'::character varying, 'DA_HOAN_TAT'::character varying, 'DA_HUY'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_gio_huy
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((trang_thai)::text <> 'DA_HUY'::text) OR ((huy_luc IS NOT NULL) AND (ly_do_huy IS NOT NULL) AND (gia_tri_khi_huy IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_hd_diem
constraints.definition: CHECK (((khach_hang_id IS NOT NULL) OR ((diem_cong = 0) AND (so_tien_mot_diem IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_hd_huy
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((trang_thai)::text <> 'DA_HUY'::text) OR ((nguoi_huy_id IS NOT NULL) AND (huy_luc IS NOT NULL) AND (ly_do_huy IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_kh_hoat_dong
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((trang_thai)::text <> 'HOAT_DONG'::text) OR ((ho_ten IS NOT NULL) AND (so_dien_thoai IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_lich_su_diem_loai_enum
constraints.definition: CHECK (((loai)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['TICH_DIEM'::character varying, 'THU_HOI_TRA_HANG'::character varying, 'THU_HOI_HUY_HOA_DON'::character varying, 'DIEU_CHINH'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_lsd_huong
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((loai)::text = 'TICH_DIEM'::text) AND (so_diem > 0) AND (hoa_don_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (((loai)::text = 'THU_HOI_TRA_HANG'::text) AND (so_diem < 0) AND (phieu_doi_tra_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (((loai)::text = 'THU_HOI_HUY_HOA_DON'::text) AND (so_diem < 0) AND (hoa_don_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (((loai)::text = 'DIEU_CHINH'::text) AND (ly_do IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_pdt_can_duyet
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT (can_duyet_qua_han OR can_duyet_danh_muc OR can_duyet_vuot_nguong)) OR ((trang_thai)::text = 'CHO_DUYET'::text) OR ((nguoi_duyet_id IS NOT NULL) AND (duyet_luc IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_pdt_doi
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((loai)::text <> 'DOI_HANG'::text) OR ((tien_hoan = 0) AND (((trang_thai)::text <> 'HOAN_TAT'::text) OR (hoa_don_moi_id IS NOT NULL)))))

constraints.name: ck_pdt_khong_can_duyet
constraints.definition: CHECK ((can_duyet_qua_han OR can_duyet_danh_muc OR can_duyet_vuot_nguong OR (((trang_thai)::text = 'HOAN_TAT'::text) AND (nguoi_duyet_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_pdt_tra
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((loai)::text <> 'TRA_HANG'::text) OR ((hoa_don_moi_id IS NULL) AND (tien_thu_them = 0) AND (tien_hoan = gia_tri_hang_tra))))

constraints.name: ck_phieu_doi_tra_trang_thai_enum
constraints.definition: CHECK (((trang_thai)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['CHO_DUYET'::character varying, 'DA_DUYET'::character varying, 'HOAN_TAT'::character varying, 'BI_TU_CHOI'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_phieu_kiem_ke_trang_thai_enum
constraints.definition: CHECK (((trang_thai)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['NHAP'::character varying, 'CHO_DUYET'::character varying, 'BI_TU_CHOI'::character varying, 'DA_DIEU_CHINH'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_phieu_xuat_huy_trang_thai_enum
constraints.definition: CHECK (((trang_thai)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['NHAP'::character varying, 'CHO_DUYET'::character varying, 'BI_TU_CHOI'::character varying, 'DA_XUAT_HUY'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_pkk_duyet
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((trang_thai)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['BI_TU_CHOI'::character varying, 'DA_DIEU_CHINH'::character varying])::text[])) OR ((nguoi_duyet_id IS NOT NULL) AND (duyet_luc IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_pn_huy
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((trang_thai)::text <> 'DA_HUY'::text) OR ((nguoi_huy_id IS NOT NULL) AND (huy_luc IS NOT NULL) AND (ly_do_huy IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_pn_xac_nhan
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((trang_thai)::text <> 'DA_NHAP_KHO'::text) OR ((nguoi_xac_nhan_id IS NOT NULL) AND (xac_nhan_luc IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_pxh_duyet
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((trang_thai)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['BI_TU_CHOI'::character varying, 'DA_XUAT_HUY'::character varying])::text[])) OR ((nguoi_duyet_id IS NOT NULL) AND (duyet_luc IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_the_kho_huong
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((loai_bien_dong)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['NHAP_HANG'::character varying, 'HUY_HOA_DON'::character varying, 'TRA_HANG'::character varying])::text[])) AND (so_luong_thay_doi > 0)) OR (((loai_bien_dong)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['BAN_HANG'::character varying, 'XUAT_HUY'::character varying])::text[])) AND (so_luong_thay_doi < 0)) OR ((loai_bien_dong)::text = 'KIEM_KE'::text)))

constraints.name: ck_the_kho_loai_bien_dong_enum
constraints.definition: CHECK (((loai_bien_dong)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['NHAP_HANG'::character varying, 'BAN_HANG'::character varying, 'HUY_HOA_DON'::character varying, 'TRA_HANG'::character varying, 'KIEM_KE'::character varying, 'XUAT_HUY'::character varying])::text[])))

    WHEN ((cach_xu_ly)::text = 'HUY'::text) THEN ((so_luong)::numeric * gia_von)
